entries.a5ba6885a7b36285: Its basic management principle is "to provide society with the beautification, safety, hygiene and labor-saving of familiar environments through the sale of high-quality environmental cleaning equipment and related products," and it states that it will make new proposals, using as its strengths demonstration sales at customer sites and product development capability based on market and field needs. As management strategy, it states that it is working on strengthening demonstration sales and product proposal capability (launching new products and developing new markets, and developing distributors and major building maintenance companies), expanding the Trading Division (partnering with distributors strong in consumer sales channels, using SNS, and OEM wholesale of original-brand products to competitors by leveraging friendly relationships with overseas manufacturers), and enhancing the after-sales service system (placing service staff at sales offices nationwide, and shortening repair times and improving technical skills through technical training).

entries.e42482c766257e08: Demand for environmental cleaning equipment is said to be affected by general domestic economic conditions and, in particular, by capital investment trends in the manufacturing industry and the business performance of the building maintenance industry. Approximately 71.8% of products handled are imported, and the business is characterized by purchasing being concentrated to a certain extent in a specific group of overseas manufacturers and by exchange rate fluctuations affecting purchasing costs. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥8,757 million, exceeding the previous fiscal year.
entries.ed330359775a1c0c: Its basic management principle is "to provide society with the beautification, safety, hygiene and labor saving of the familiar environment through the sale of high-quality environmental cleaning equipment," and it says it will make new proposals using its demonstration sales at customers' sites and its product development ability based on market and on-site needs.
entries.f0bbdc01446dc8d9: This business imports cleaning and washing equipment for commercial, industrial and consumer use (environmental cleaning equipment), manufactured to the company's specifications by manufacturers in Europe and the United States, China and others, and sells it throughout Japan. External revenue by product group for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,779 million for cleaning equipment, ¥3,839 million for washing equipment, and ¥3,138 million for others (parts and maintenance services, consumables and accessories, water purifying agents, general home appliances, etc.). It has 20 sales offices and 1 branch office nationwide, and also maintains a logistics center and a testing and research laboratory in Funabashi, Chiba Prefecture.
